hero_kpi_rationale: The acquisition of Alimera Sciences in September 2024 marks a major strategic milestone for ANI Pharmaceuticals, adding key products such as ILUVIEN and YUTIQ and expanding its portfolio in ophthalmic rare diseases.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Alimera Sciences
kpis.explanation: Amount of term loan used to finance the acquisition of Alimera Sciences, including associated fees and expenses.
kpis.description: The financing of the Alimera Sciences acquisition through a $325 million term loan underscores the company's external growth ambition.
kpis.signal: Major strategic acquisition to expand the product portfolio in ophthalmic rare diseases.

kpis.name: Available revolving credit facility
kpis.explanation: Amount available for borrowing under the $75 million revolving credit facility.
kpis.description: The revolving credit facility provides financial flexibility, with $74.9 million available as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Availability of funds for future operational and strategic needs.

kpis.name: Proceeds from the sale of the Oakville site
kpis.explanation: Amount received from the sale of the manufacturing facility in Oakville, Ontario, converted into U.S. dollars.
kpis.description: The sale of the Oakville plant for $14.2 million (CAD 19.2 million) is part of a restructuring of Canadian operations.
kpis.signal: Asset rationalization to improve operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Cost of SWK royalty buyback
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to repurchase future royalty rights on combined ILUVIEN and YUTIQ sales from SWK Funding LLC.
kpis.description: The exercise of the royalty buyback option for $17.3 million on March 17, 2025 eliminates future royalty payments to SWK on net revenues starting January 1, 2025.
kpis.signal: Elimination of royalty payments to improve future margins on ILUVIEN and YUTIQ.

kpis.name: ILUVIEN and YUTIQ products
kpis.explanation: Ophthalmic pharmaceutical products acquired with Alimera, used to treat specific eye diseases.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Alimera added ILUVIEN and YUTIQ to ANI Pharmaceuticals' portfolio, expanding its offering in the treatment of eye diseases, including diabetic macular edema and non-infectious uveitis.
kpis.signal: Portfolio expansion in rare and chronic eye diseases with significant market potential.

kpis.name: ILUVIEN label expansion for uveitis
kpis.explanation: FDA approval of an expanded indication for ILUVIEN for the treatment of chronic non-infectious posterior uveitis.
kpis.description: The FDA's expanded label approval for ILUVIEN in March 2025 for the treatment of non-infectious uveitis affecting the posterior segment of the eye opens new market opportunities for this product.
kpis.signal: Doubling of ILUVIEN's market potential through a new indication for non-infectious uveitis.

risks.title: Product dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the commercialization of its products, including Cortrophin Gel and ILUVIEN, to maintain profitability.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly regarding product safety and efficacy, and must comply with regulatory authority requirements.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with rival firms potentially developing similar or more effective products.

risks.title: Supplier dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for product manufacturing, which may create risks related to the availability and quality of raw materials.

risks.title: Patent risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must protect its patents and intellectual property rights, which may create risks related to infringement or patent loss.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company uses information technology to operate, which may create cybersecurity risks, including in the event of an attack or data breach.

risks.title: Reputation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain a positive reputation, which may create risks related to loss of customer or investor confidence.
